meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 让 Claude 能用 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作 Benchling 平台：管理 DNA、RNA、蛋白等注册实体，处理库存样品与容器，增改电子实验记录本条目，创建工作流任务，并通过 AWS EventBridge 或 Webhooks 订阅数据变更，还能用 SQL 查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当用户要求用 benchling-sdk 或 v2 API 自动化实验室数据，或涉及管理 Benchling 序列、库存、实验记录本等操作时接管。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到盒子 box_xyz789 里。
查询数据仓库里上个月的实验聚合结果。
say.note: 会通过 Data Warehouse 执行 SQL 查询。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to operate Benchling via Python SDK or REST API: manage DNA/RNA/protein registry entities, handle inventory samples and containers, create/update ELN entries, create workflow tasks, subscribe to changes via AWS EventBridge or webhooks, and run SQL queries against the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to automate lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or mentions operations on Benchling sequences, inventory, ELN entries, etc.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named "My Plasmid" with bases ATCGATCG using benchling-sdk.
Transfer container cont_abc123 to box box_xyz789.
Query last month's aggregated experiment results from the Data Warehouse.
